title: The Keeper and the Storm
logline: A solitary lighthouse keeper befriends a sentient storm that visits his island each night.
style_bible: Hand-drawn animation with watercolour textures, reminiscent of a graphic novel. Deep blues, teal, and warm amber light. Soft, diffused lighting with glowing edges. The lighthouse beam cuts through mist. Early 20th century, rustic, isolated. Non-photorealistic, painterly rendering.

characters.name: Eamon
characters.description: Elderly man, thin, weathered skin, grey hair cropped short, sharp jaw, kind blue eyes.
characters.wardrobe: Heavy wool peacoat, dark blue sweater, worn leather boots.
characters.distinguishing_feature: A brass compass on a chain around his neck, always glowing faintly.

characters.name: Vael
characters.description: Personification of a storm: a swirling vortex of dark clouds, with fleeting, luminous blue eyes and crackling lightning veins.
characters.distinguishing_feature: Eyes of lightning that flicker and a constant low rumbling presence.

shots.summary: The lighthouse keeper stands alone on the gallery, lighting the lamp as dusk settles.
shots.location: Lighthouse gallery, encircled by iron railing, overlooking a stormy sea.

timeline.action: Hero climbs the spiral staircase, reaches the lamp room, and begins lighting the wick with a long match.
Hero adjusts the Fresnel lens, the beam sweeps across the sea; he then steps out onto the gallery.
Hero leans on the railing, gazing at the darkening horizon; wind tugs his coat, and his compass glows.

shots.camera: Wide-angle lens, slow dolly in from a high angle, then orbit around hero as he lights the lamp, settling on a medium shot from behind.
shots.continuity: Amber glow from the lamp, hero's coat flapping, brass compass visible on chain, iron railing wet with mist.
shots.audio: Wind howling, distant waves, rhythmic creak of the lighthouse mechanism, soft cello music bed.

shots.summary: The storm arrives, sentient and curious, causing the light to flicker.

timeline.action: Hero sees dark clouds churning on the horizon, wind intensifies, and he grips the railing.
Storm vortex forms near the lighthouse, sparks of lightning reveal its swirling shape and eyes.
Storm reaches out a tendril of cloud toward the lamp, causing the light to flicker erratically.
Hero braces against the wind, holding his compass, staring at the sentient storm.

shots.camera: Static wide shot of the gallery, then quick zoom to the storm's forming face, handheld shake during the tendril reach.
shots.continuity: Same gallery, lamp now lit and casting a beam, heavy rain drenching hero's coat, compass glowing brighter.
shots.audio: Thunder crashes, storm's rumbling voice, scattered piano notes, lighthouse mechanism groans.

shots.summary: The keeper offers his lamp's warmth, and the storm calms.

timeline.action: Hero reaches out a hand toward the storm, which recoils slightly, its eyes flickering.
Hero opens the lamp housing, warm amber light spills out; storm's tendrils swirl around it, calming.
Storm's eyes soften, its form becomes more fluid; hero and storm share a quiet moment.

shots.continuity: Light from lamp bathes both, storm's form now less jagged, more fluid, hero's compass is bright, rain begins to abate.
shots.audio: Wind subsides, gentle chimes, soft strings, distant thunder rumbles.

shots.summary: The storm departs at dawn, leaving a glowing token on the gallery.

timeline.action: Hero looks at the horizon where the storm dissipates into soft clouds; dawn light breaks.
Hero notices a smooth, glowing stone on the railing, left behind by the storm.
